resolution.reason: 规格已将授权单位改为精确外层命令事务：focused integration 预算 1 次 runner；完整 local/CI V1 verify 绑定当前 plan 且预算最多 2 次（regression_tests 与 coverage_xml），提前失败不复用余额，任何重跑重新批准。

findings.title: Single-run delete approval cannot cover the complete V1 transaction

summary: The frozen design is structurally implementable, but its single-use delete approval is scoped to one five-probe runner invocation while the frozen V1 verification transaction collects the real integration test twice through regression_tests and coverage_xml. The current authorization unit therefore cannot support a compliant full V1 replay.
